parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: Specifies whether to allow or deny access.

parameters.name: IdentityType
parameters.description:
The identity type. Valid values:

*   USER
*   CLIENT

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: ID of the Cloud Message Queue MQTT version instance.

parameters.name: PermitAction
parameters.description: The permissions that you want to grant.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: Authorized Topic, supporting multi-level MQTT topics and wildcards.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt update-custom-auth-permission --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --identity-type USER --identity test --permit-action PUB_SUB --effect ALLOW --topic test/t1 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt UpdateCustomAuthPermission --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'post-cn-0pp12gl0000' --PermitAction PUB_SUB --Effect ALLOW --Identity test --Topic 'test/t1'
